scope.outlet: Rio Taquari na confluência com o Rio Jacuí
scope.important_note_2: The 32 IEDE polygons are audit/grouping units only; they are not HEC computational sub-basins.
scope.important_note: Muçum is an internal control point, not the basin outlet.

forcing_policy.observed_rain: hourly accumulated precipitation, station QC, spatialized separately for each of the 32 sub-basins; missing never becomes zero
forcing_policy.forecast_rain: ECMWF/IFS spatial field integrated over each sub-basin polygon
forcing_policy.station_rule: nested hydrometric gauges are diagnostics/state constraints and are never blindly summed as independent tributaries

state_and_calibration_policy.initial_state: use fresh observed non-overlapping branch controls where available; otherwise warm-up from rainfall-runoff states
state_and_calibration_policy.publish_gate: native HEC state must pass level/flow/trend/recent-hydrograph criteria; diagnostic stage shifting cannot promote a run
state_and_calibration_policy.calibration: multi-event and branch-wise first; only then test transferable parameter regions across G040

hydraulic_boundary_note: HEC-HMS can provide basin runoff/flow hydrographs. Forecasting stage/inundation in the lower Taquari where Jacuí/Guaíba backwater matters requires a hydraulic model (e.g. HEC-RAS) downstream of the hydrologic model.
